facts.fact: The Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education has launched a national initiative, funded by GPE, to build a DHIS2-based learner-centred education data hub joining the annual school census, teacher management and examination data, rolling out across all 16 districts.
The hub's Unique Learner ID, to be piloted in four districts, assigns each learner an identifier linked to the NCRA-issued National Identification Number where available, per the DHIS2 article.
